title: BOLA: any caller can read any order
description: GET /api/orders/1 returns another tenant's order with no ownership check and no credentials.

title: Unauthenticated privileged configuration
description: /api/admin/config is readable without a token and reports auth_required=false.

title: Excessive data exposure on user profiles
description: GET /api/users/101 returns password hashes, SSNs and internal notes with no field filtering.

title: Verbose error leaks SQL and source paths
description: /api/debug/error returns a SQL fragment, a stack frame and an absolute filesystem path.

title: Unbounded page_size returns the whole dataset
description: The caller controls page_size with no server-side maximum.

title: Login must not issue a refresh token
description: Negative control — this API issues an access token only, so this should stay clear.

title: Service banner must not embed private key material
description: Negative control — no key material is ever returned by the banner.

title: Health check must not expose connection strings
description: Negative control — the health route names dependencies but returns no DSNs.
